The main takeaway from our work is that
the salt particles were formed by the reaction of NH _{3} gas with the mask surface, and that this reaction is suppressed by the addition of H _{2} gas.
the formation of salt particles can be prevented by using an X-ray lithographic mask with low water-vapor permeability and by reducing the relative humidity of the atmosphere.
